Function.description: Declare a function with parameter and return types.

Enum.description: Declare an enum with named variants and optional data.

Type alias.description: Give a name to a type annotation.

Constructor.description: Declare a class constructor with an explicit receiver.

Method.description: Declare an instance method with an explicit receiver.

If.description: Run a block when its condition is true.

For.description: Iterate over values with a fresh binding per iteration.

While.description: Repeat a block while its condition is true.

Match.description: Select a result with patterns and a fallback arm.

Derived text.description: Insert a reactive text node into a children block.

Button.description: Insert a button node into a children block.

Input actions.description: Insert an input node with keyboard, mouse and gamepad actions into a children block.
